summary: The bad() entry point reads a URL from a file and passes it directly to response.sendRedirect(), allowing an open redirect if the file content points to an attacker-controlled external site. The fix validates the parsed URI before redirecting: only relative URLs (no scheme and no authority/host) are allowed, which preserves legitimate same-application redirects while rejecting absolute off-site URLs. Invalid or external URLs produce an error message instead of a redirect.
